title: Message
description: A sentence in a tone, said to whoever reads the page: an information, a success, a warning, an error — or a note for the developers. The tone is one of the message's values, not a kind of message of its own: a message is one thing in several tones, as it is drawn. The words are the body; a title heads them when they need one; an icon says the tone at a glance, and one action may be offered when there is one thing to do about it.

type.description: The tone: how the message is drawn and the icon it carries when none is given.

body.description: What is said, as it is read.

title.description: A heading over the body, when the body needs one.

icon.description: An icon name (`ph:bold/info`); null for the tone's own, false for none at all.

action.description: The one thing to do about it: where it leads, and where it opens there — a panel, a modal — without leaving the page.

target.description: Where it opens: `panel`, `modal`; none, the page goes there.
